plugins.name: architects
plugins.description: Specialist architecture agents for Go, Vue and TypeScript, OpenAPI, dependency layering, Ansible automation, and project setup validation.

plugins.name: coding-guides
plugins.description: Injects standing coding conventions into sessions and subagents, enforces selected tool-use rules, and adds /tldr for short, plain-language summaries and /explain for a numbered walk-through of how code works.

plugins.name: doc-authoring
plugins.description: Skills for maintaining internal, agent-facing project documentation.

plugins.name: factory
plugins.description: Delivery commands from writing code to merging it. /auto-deliver hands off the rest of a feature, /auto-improve runs an unattended review-and-fix pass on the current branch, /next-iteration builds the ready tasks from the todo list, /review-pr prints a multi-reviewer review of a pull request without posting it, and /review-branch reviews the current branch with uncommitted work and offers to fix the findings. Token-cheap, script-backed Git commands (/new-branch, /open-pr, /ship) branch, open the PR, wait for CI, and merge, using an expensive PR writer only for complex changes. /generate-readme writes the root README.md and DEVELOPMENT.md.

plugins.name: go-idioms
plugins.description: Go best-practice skills covering Effective Go and idiomatic patterns.

plugins.name: session-sounds
plugins.description: Plays a bundled sound when Claude finishes responding (Stop) and on notifications, via paplay.
